name: Penguin

app.note: The crown of the mesh is its highest point, at 1.0 u, and the scale puts it at the head top of the egg penguin, 1.043 m. Thus the scale is 1.043 m for each unit, and the standing shoulder joints are at 0.6 u (0.6258 m).

armFactorNote: The factor of the upper arm and the forearm. The flippers keep the length of the mesh (0.2381 m from the shoulder joint to the middle of the palm), and the folder comes to the flippers (CHOIR_FOLDER of src/models/instruments/folder.ts).
legFactorNote: The legs keep the length of the mesh. The penguin stands on its riser, so no seat asks for longer legs.
jointsNote: The places are in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the crown, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The body is one egg with no neck. The penguin has no ears, so each ear joint lies inside the crown. The jaw joint lies at the hinge of the beak.

studio.note: The penguin stands on its riser, and its legs hide in the egg, so each leg turn is the identity, and the trunk does not recline (open 0). The upper arm of the bind points out, down, and forward, at 40 degrees below the level, so that no face of the flipper root turns over.

haunch.note: The part of the thigh weight that goes to the hips grows from 0 at the knee to 1 at the thigh joint, so that the bottom of the egg stays on the hips.

weights.note: Beyond the plane |x| = armSplit, only the free flipper follows the arm bones. Above headFrom, the narrowest cut under the head, each vertex follows the head only. The tail is a ball on one bone (tailBall). clavicleFrom and armTop are the rules of the rhino.

jaw.note: Each vertex of the lower part of the beak, in the box of the beak and below the mouth plane, follows the jaw only (tools/blender/penguin_beak.py). The corners of the mouth lie on the plane and stay on the head.

refine.ringsNote: The config has no rings. pnpm rig-mesh penguin --check lists the thin faces near the joints as candidates for a ring (check.thin).

flank.note: The texture paints the black flipper larger than the flipper of the mesh. Thus each black face of the side forward of the line from the armpit to the lower side takes the white of the nearest light face (flank_faces() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), so that a raised flipper leaves no black band on the white side.

colors.splitNote: A face whose samples spread over more than 0.3 of Oklab lightness takes the mean of the larger of its light and dark halves (face_colors() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). Thus the edge between the black and the white is sharp, with no gray band.

shift.note: The pale yellow throat and cheeks take a quarter of their chroma, so that the front is white from the beak to the feet, as in orchestra-latest.png and SPECIES_COLORS.penguin (shift_colors() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The white, the black, and the orange parts keep their colors.

colors.note: The black of the head, the back, and the flippers is the color of the penguin, so a face is dark only below the dark limit 0.0055. A dark face in the eye box is an eye. The config has no nose box, so the beak keeps its orange.

eyeShell.note: The values of the other meshes. The eyes are black in the black of the head, so the shell takes no dark faces around the eye (darkReach 0), as for the panda.

chair.note: The chair of the rig sets the seat top of the seated bind, but the penguin stands in the app, so no player sits on this seat. The front edge lies behind the feet, and the back edge in front of the tail.

sourceNote: The mesh with the beak split along the mouth line and closed with caps of a dark mouth color (tools/blender/penguin_beak.py). The faces across the black and white edge of the texture are cut along that edge (tools/blender/penguin_edge.py). See assets/models/penguin/README.md. penguin.glb does not change.
